Auto-bid on sports cards on eBay
A commenter said Claude built an app that scans eBay, pulls historic comparisons, calculates margins and automatically bids on sports cards.
·
Nov 19, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
A commenter said they use Claude for a sports-card side hustle by having it build an app that scans eBay, pulls past comparable sales, calculates potential profit margins, and automatically places bids. The thread does not add any further details about the app’s setup, data sources beyond eBay comps, or what parts the person still handled manually.
How it went
The stated result is that it supports their hobby of buying and selling sports cards. The source gives no numbers, performance results, or examples of wins or mistakes.
Worth knowing
The catch is that the comment is very thin: it confirms the workflow at a high level but gives no build steps, tools, costs, or safeguards for auto-bidding.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Help me build a small tool that scans eBay for [type of item, e.g. sports cards] listings ending soon, pulls recent sold prices for comparison, and calculates my expected margin after fees and shipping. It should output a ranked list of listings worth bidding on, with my max bid for each based on a [target margin]% margin. Do not place any real bids; show me the list and wait for my go-ahead.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1y07g9e/what_are_your_best_uses_of_claude_for_improving
